Hero_Desc_TigHero:
Tig, reborn as a hero through spiritual growth.
She tries to leave her immature past behind and display a magnificent new self,
but sometimes she wants to set everything aside and simply play.
Album_TigHero1: Tig received a share of my power and was reborn as something new. I acted impulsively because the heart and thoughts we shared moved me, but I do not regret it. Since then, Tig also seems to work tirelessly so that she will not disappoint me.
Album_TigHero2: Her upright attitude and composure are qualities Tig never possessed before, so I often struggle to adjust to this mature form. It did not make her any more intelligent, however, and she still says clumsy things from time to time... Perhaps that cannot be helped.
Album_TigHero3: Diana seems deeply moved by Tig's transformation. Fascinated and blushing, she often becomes completely absorbed in stroking Tig. Every Diana does the same.
Album_TigHero4: The other residents of the Beastfolk Village are also bewildered by Tig's new appearance. Rufo refuses to believe her eyes, Leon is astonished, while Beni claims she always knew this would happen. Their reactions vary, and Tig often seems privately embarrassed and burdened by them.
Album_TigHero5: Since assuming her new form, Tig frequently visits the Order and spends time with me. She learns knowledge she lacks while helping with paperwork, and in return teaches me swordsmanship. She seems to deliberately go easy on me and show excessive consideration, but I am relieved that her teaching is nothing like Diana's forceful methods.
Album_TigHero6: Tig sometimes seems to miss her former days as a troublemaker. When she sees Rufo and Beni playing, she often watches in silent hesitation, apparently wanting to join them. Although Tig has matured, could she remain a child deep within her heart?
Album_TigHero7: I advised Tig not to burden herself and to act freely as she wished. She worried and hesitated for a long time, but ultimately seems happiest playing with friends her own age. It is wonderful to see her set down her neat cape along with the weight upon her heart, return to her lively former self, and run with her friends.
LoveHero_TigHero: Calling for me? Fine, I will protect you!
LoveHeroCancel_TigHero: I am going to play with Suro! Call me again if you need me later~!
Food_ChefNote_TigHero_Hate1: She placed the candy in her mouth, declared that it was still disgusting, and angrily demanded to know whether the day when it tasted good would ever come.
Food_ChefNote_TigHero_Hate2: She became furious that I served this again after she broke the sign last time, then destroyed the door instead. Why...?
Food_ChefNote_TigHero_Like1: She complained that perhaps she had grown too strong to feel any stronger from drinking this juice. Then she asked for an entire crate...
Food_ChefNote_TigHero_Like2: Tig raised a thumb and declared that grilled meat made by the Master was still the finest.
Food_ChefNote_TigHero_Like3: She began demanding to know why eating this was supposed to make her older, yet never made her grow. I may need to explain it again.
Food_ChefNote_TigHero_Like4: She said she knew it was a sweet dessert rather than a log and promised to demonstrate elegant knife work. Then she split the table in half again.
Food_ChefNote_TigHero_Like5: She says it sharply restores her senses when training leaves her tired. She asked for extra, so I packed a great deal, and she left in delight.
Food_ChefNote_TigHero_Like6: She said she recently preferred red bean filling to honey and asked whether she could order only one. Naturally, I said no.
Food_ChefNote_TigHero_Like7: She accidentally overturned the box last time, but insisted she would never make that mistake again. With trembling hands, she carefully removed and treasured each piece.
Food_ChefNote_TigHero_Like8: She happily poured everything into her mouth at once and began coughing, so I gave her cool water. Saying it tasted even better with water, she began dissolving Yum-Yum Vita-C directly into the glass.
Food_ChefNote_TigHero_Like9: After tossing several into her mouth at once, she asked whether every color tasted the same. Hearing that while she ate so happily was mildly irritating.

LoveLetter_TigHero:
Master! It feels like a while since I saw your face. When are you coming to the Beastfolk Forest? We need to continue the swordsmanship training we started last time. You are not lying and staying away because you hate training, are you?

Plenty of people in the Beastfolk Forest want to see you, so make time to visit. You can train while you are here. That way, the next time something happens, you can come along and distinguish yourself beside me!

Anyway, you had better come! Understood? If you do not, I will go find you!
LoveCall_TigHero:
Ah, Master! It is Tig. Have you... been well?
What? Why am I suddenly checking on you when it does not suit me? Nngh...
Quiet! I did not call merely to ask how you were! There is an important reason!
What is it? Th-That is...

Whew. The truth is... my training has not gone well lately.
Of course I am still working hard with the old hag and Suro... but something feels different.
Nngh, it is so irritating! Thoughts of you keep billowing through my head!
By billowing, I mean... Nngh, aaah!
I do not know! I do not know either! Whether I swing my sword or headbutt something, your face refuses to leave my sight! What am I supposed to do?!
What did you do to me?! Is this because of what entered my body that time?!

Anyway, where are you? I am going there now. ...I need to see your face immediately.
Do not act annoyed! This happened because of you, so take responsibility and fix it!
I-I am coming, so stay exactly where you are.
